title: Solo games
body: Play in the configured games channel. Only the member who started a puzzle can control it. There is no entry fee. Wins earn a small configured Ottoman reward within a shared rolling 24-hour cap. Rounds expire at the shown time. Play Again creates a new puzzle and result, preserves valid board settings and never changes the previous result.

games.hangman: Guess letters; six incorrect letters ends the round. Repeated guesses do not consume a turn.
games.wordscramble: Unscramble the word in six guesses. Submit the whole word.
games.mastermind: Find four digits from 1–6 in ten guesses. Repeated digits are allowed. Exact and misplaced feedback never reveals the hidden code.
games.minesweeper: Reveal every safe cell. Choose size 4 for 4×4 with three mines, or size 5 for 5×5 with five mines. First reveal is safe. Toggle flags before revealing protected cells.

fields.guess: Enter the letter, word or code requested by the current game.
fields.cell: Enter the numbered cell shown on the board.

steps: Choose a solo game in the games channel.
Read Rules and the expiry time.
Use Guess, Reveal Cell or Toggle Flag.
View the saved result and bounded reward.
Choose Play Again for a fresh puzzle.
